The discussion focused on investigating unusual behavior in ad metrics, specifically the relationship between sessions and unique identifiers (yuniks) for Latvia. Initial checks confirmed that overall totals were fine, but a discrepancy was noted regarding the ratio of sessions to unique IDs on a specific day.

Later, a potential issue with data calibration was discussed, which led someone to find a problem in the system but not its root cause. The conversation concluded with scheduling model reprocessing for April 20th, requiring careful handling due to different models across categories.
decisions: Model reprocessing for 2021-04-20 will be scheduled for the next day.
